scripts.dev:setup: pnpm install && pnpm -C services/api install && pnpm -C services/ingest install && pnpm -C services/orchestrator install && pnpm -C frontend install
scripts.build: pnpm run build:common && pnpm run build:back && pnpm run build:front
scripts.build:back: pnpm -C services/api build && pnpm -C services/ingest build && pnpm -C services/orchestrator build && pnpm -C services/mcp-ariadne build && pnpm run build:link && pnpm -C services/mcp-docs build && pnpm -C services/cartographer build
scripts.build:ingest: pnpm run build:common && pnpm -C services/ingest build
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run test:ingest && pnpm run test:frontend:unit
